page_title: SAS 1-2 ROM | Sassuolo v AS Roma 03/12/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+4' Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma) receives a great pass inside the box and misses a golden chance. The goalkeeper pulls off a stunning save.
90+3' A yellow card for a tackle by Martin Erlic (Sassuolo). Matteo Marcenaro doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
90' 7 additional min. will be played.
90' The corner is swung in but Sassuolo can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
90' Alessio Dionisi has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Marcus Pedersen (Sassuolo) replacing Matias Vina.
90' The substitution is prepared. Samu Castillejo (Sassuolo) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Domenico Berardi.
88' Uros Racic (Sassuolo) receives a good pass just outside the box, unleashes a strike from a promising position, but the shot is blocked by the defender. Now Sassuolo have a corner.
88' Rasmus Kristensen (AS Roma) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Andrea Consigli, who smothers the ball.
87' Here comes a substitution. Zeki Celik (AS Roma) is brought on as a substitute for Paulo Dybala.
86' That was close by Uros Racic (Sassuolo)! He receives a pass on the edge of the box and shoots, but the ball goes by a whisker over the crossbar.
86' Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma) steps up to take the corner. He launches the ball into the penalty area, but it only finds the head of an opposing player who clears the danger.
84' Matheus Henrique (Sassuolo) receives a yellow card from the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
82' 1 - 2 Goal! Paulo Dybala plays it to Rasmus Kristensen (AS Roma), whose deflected shot from inside the box goes past the helpless Andrea Consigli. 1:2.
81' The manager makes a subsitution with Gregoire Defrel (Sassuolo) coming on for Andrea Pinamonti.
81' Kristian Thorstvedt will be replaced by Nedim Bajrami (Sassuolo).
79' Matteo Marcenaro shows a yellow card to Rasmus Kristensen (AS Roma) for his blatant foul.
76' 1 - 1 Goal! Andrea Consigli gets a hand on the penalty from Paulo Dybala (AS Roma), but can't stop it from flying into the bottom right corner.
76' Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
75' A player from Sassuolo takes his opponent down, the referee blows his whistle for a foul. The advantage of a penalty kick is given to AS Roma.
74' Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma) takes a short corner kick.
73' The statistic for corner kicks – 0:9.
70' Bryan Cristante (AS Roma) creates himself some space in front of goal and connects with the resulting free kick. His header is so wild it sails way past the right post and behind for a goal kick.
69' Domenico Berardi (Sassuolo) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Matteo Marcenaro had an easy-decision to make.
67' Jose Mourinho decides to make a substitution. Gianluca Mancini will be replaced by Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma).
67' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Leonardo Spinazzola as he is replaced by Stephan El Shaarawy (AS Roma).
67' AS Roma earn a corner.
65' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Armand Lauriente walks off the pitch to be replaced by Uros Racic (Sassuolo).
63' It’s taken a long time, but here comes the VAR review into that red card for Daniel Boloca (Sassuolo): it’s upheld, he has to go!

63' There's a break in play and the referee must have got a signal in his ear as he indicates he will check that earlier infringement by Daniel Boloca (Sassuolo) using VAR. This could result in a red card!
62' Daniel Boloca (Sassuolo) lunges into his opponent and is relieved when the referee only shows him a yellow card.
61' Kristian Thorstvedt (Sassuolo) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee Matteo Marcenaro who sees an offensive foul.
59' Leandro Paredes (AS Roma) sends in the corner, but fails to find the head of any of his teammates, allowing the defence to clear.
59' Rasmus Kristensen (AS Roma) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. It will be a corner kick for AS Roma.
58' The linesman raises his flag. Romelu Lukaku (AS Roma) is adjudged offside.
56' Sardar Azmoun (AS Roma) threw away a promising scoring opportunity. He received a fine cross inside the 6-yard box, but missed to the left of the target.
55' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Kristian Thorstvedt (Sassuolo) was quite harsh and Matteo Marcenaro didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.

52' Romelu Lukaku (AS Roma) must feel embarrassed now. He received a killer pass, but his shot from the six-yard box was a disaster. He miskicked and made it very easy for Andrea Consigli to get hold of the ball.
52' One of the AS Roma players is in on goal but gets upended by the defender in the box. That could be a penalty, but the ref says NO! Play continues.
47' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from AS Roma comes to nothing.
46' Here is a change after the half-time break. Edoardo Bove is replaced by Sardar Azmoun (AS Roma).
46' Half-time substitution. Rick Karsdorp will not participate anymore and Rasmus Kristensen (AS Roma) is coming on.
46' Matteo Marcenaro blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45+2' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+1' Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) launches a powerful cross from the corner into the box, but the ball is intercepted by the defender.
45+1' Rick Karsdorp (AS Roma) receives a sweet pass inside the box, but his effort on goal is blocked by the defender. The ball is out of play. AS Roma win a corner kick.
45' The fourth official shows 1 min. of added time.

43' He should have scored! Kristian Thorstvedt (Sassuolo) latches onto a pull back in the box right in front of goal, but his shot towards the middle of the goal is pretty weak and Rui Patricio makes an easy save.
42' Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) is heading toward the corner flag to take the set piece.
41' The resulting corner from Leandro Paredes (AS Roma) only finds one of the defenders, who heads it out of danger.

39' Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) does well to control a poor pass on the edge of the box then shoots towards the top right corner. Andrea Consigli is out of position but leaps to make a brilliant save. The referee blows his whistle, AS Roma are awarded a corner kick.
39' Romelu Lukaku (AS Roma) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
38' Leonardo Spinazzola (AS Roma) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Sassuolo.
37' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo).
35' Leandro Paredes (AS Roma) takes the corner and sends it into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and makes a good clearance.
34' Leandro Paredes (AS Roma) swings in the corner, but it's comfortably cleared away.
34' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Leonardo Spinazzola (AS Roma). The linesman points to the corner flag, AS Roma are going to take it.
33' Leonardo Spinazzola (AS Roma) clips an inviting cross into the box, but there's no one in a position to get on the end of it.
31' Ruan Tressoldi (Sassuolo) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
29' Leonardo Spinazzola (AS Roma) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
25' 1 - 0 Goal - 1:0! Domenico Berardi tees up Matheus Henrique (Sassuolo) inside the box and he rolls the ball into the bottom right corner and past Rui Patricio.
24' Gianluca Mancini (AS Roma) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Matteo Marcenaro has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
24' The AS Roma players are exchanging some short passes.
18' Matheus Henrique (Sassuolo) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
16' A clumsy foul by Leandro Paredes (AS Roma) and Matteo Marcenaro blows his whistle.
15' The ball goes out for a corner. AS Roma can continue in their attacking effort.
13' Andrea Pinamonti (Sassuolo) connects with a cross from the side, but produces a header which goes miles wide of the right post.
13' Bryan Cristante (AS Roma) is penalised after knocking an opponent down. Sassuolo have a free kick.
12' Edoardo Bove (AS Roma) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Matteo Marcenaro signals.

9' Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) receives a low pass just outside the box and drills a fine strike towards the middle of the goal. Andrea Consigli pulls off a reflexive save to block his effort. Nice goalkeeping skill, indeed.
9' Martin Erlic (Sassuolo) was too forceful with his tackle and Matteo Marcenaro interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
6' Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders.
4' The AS Roma players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
Sassuolo will kick-off.
Matteo Marcenaro got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
Show lineups Before the start of the game, you can see the starting lineups for today's clash.
